title: What's New in v2.9.55
notes: 🔄 Unified Championship Event Reset: The Event Reset command now comprehensively wipes battle matchup info (scores, flags, opponents) and resets all member signups in the tracker from YES back to NO.
📜 Dual Timestamped Archiving: Both completed 5-round battle records and member signup attendance snapshots are automatically preserved into Firebase history before resetting.
🛡️ Header & Footer Reset Controls: Added 'Event Reset' quick buttons to the top action header and signups table footer in the Championship Admin Suite.

latestChanges: v2.9.55: Unified Championship Event Reset to clean battle info and reset signups from YES to NO with dual archiving
v2.9.54: Added Screenshot & Image Attachment support (Upload, Drag-and-Drop, Clipboard Paste, Lightbox Viewer) to Bug Tracker
v2.9.53: Added dual-sided Season Flag fields to Season Details card and total flags summary banner to public dashboard
v2.9.52: Launched in-app Feature Request & Bug Tracker with community upvoting and interactive Admin checklist
